subject: Embed adapter / LangChain POC — scope & procurement
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@explorerkits.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 13:14:00 -0500
Subject: Embed adapter / LangChain POC — scope & terms

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — ExplorerKits is excited about Redwood's embedding quality and the runtime performance you showed. We want to run a focused POC to validate two things: (1) a LangChain-friendly adapter/connector for our retrieval pipelines, and (2) end-to-end tracing/token attribution so we can reconcile cost and QA between our app and Redwood.

Target goals:
- LangChain connector with the ability to swap Redwood embeddings in (vector store + helper utilities)
- Tracing hooks that map top-level user requests to per-call token counts and model variant used
- A small eval: 5k queries against our test index with latency and recall targets

Questions for you:
1) What pilot credits or terms do you offer for an ISV POC?
2) What data/security artifacts do you need for a quick security review (SOC2, data flow diagram, retention policy)?
3) Suggested timeline — we were hoping for a 3–4 week POC starting early Jan.

I can make procurement/technical folks available. Attaching a short doc with our evaluation dataset notes (we will share the dataset link after NDA).

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Integrations, ExplorerKits
elena@explorerkits.ai

Attachments: ExplorerKits_eval_readme.md (stub)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@explorerkits.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Embed adapter / LangChain POC — scope & terms

Elena — really appreciate the clear goals. We're excited to partner on this. Next steps from Redwood:

1) Mutual Action Plan (MAP): can you share a one-pager with objectives, success criteria, and procurement contact? We'll fill in roles/timeline on our side.
2) Pilot credits: we can offer $15k of hosted credits for a 4-week POC plus a reduced-rate option for the first 30 days of production if you decide to continue. Vanessa will confirm commercial details below.
3) Security artifacts: please send your external-facing security questionnaire and an NDA if you want us to share SOC2 docs and the data flow diagram. We typically require a minimal data minimization policy for POCs.
4) Technical: Marissa, can you draft an integration checklist (LangChain patterns, SDK versions, tracing hooks, and a quick starter sample)? Marissa — please include templates for a quick-conformance trace test so ExplorerKits can validate token attribution.

Suggested timeline: kickoff week of Jan 4, two-week integration window to get a LangChain connector working, followed by a 2-week eval run.

I uploaded our SOW template and a short connector guide here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxx-example-integration-guide

Happy to set a 30-minute kickoff this week to align.

— Mateo
Sr. Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:31:00 -05:00
Subject: RE: Embed adapter / LangChain POC — scope & terms

Elena — welcome, and glad to see the alignment here. On the commercial side:

- Pilot package: $15k hosted credits (applied to usage) + 20% discount on first 12 months if you transition to a committed plan within 60 days of completing the POC.
- Pricing note: shared embeddings usage for ISVs is billed per embedding unit — we'll provide an estimated burn rate once you share expected query volume.
- Procurement: please introduce your procurement contact (Ben or legal@explorerkits.ai). We'll route an MSA and SOW for signature; our legal team will accept reasonable redlines but we prefer to keep the SOW lean for pilots.

Attaching a short summary PDF with the pilot terms.

If this looks good I'm happy to spin up a deal in HubSpot and route the SOW for signature.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@explorerkits.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:46:00 -05:00
Subject: RE: Embed adapter / LangChain POC — integration checklist

Elena / team — quick technical checklist and notes to make the POC low-friction:

1) LangChain connector patterns: we recommend using the Retriever -> VectorStore pattern with our embeddings adapter (v0.9.2+). We'll provide a reference connector that implements caching and basic batching.
2) Tracing/token attribution: we require a request_id header propagated from ExplorerKits to Redwood. We'll map request_id -> job_id in our tracing system. For the POC please use our JS SDK (2.x) or Python SDK (1.4+) helpers; the sample code will demonstrate how to attach request_id and user metadata.
3) Test harness: attach integration_spec.md (contains acceptance tests) and trace_requirements.xlsx (expected fields and example traces). Run the acceptance test with 100 sample queries before the full 5k run.
4) Security: production keys are not needed for POC — use scoped test API keys. If you need us to sign an NDA to receive SOC2 artifacts, we'll expedite it.

I attached two files: integration_spec.md and trace_requirements.xlsx. I'll also push a small reference repo with the LangChain example by EOD today.

— Marissa
Principal SDK Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: integration_spec.md, trace_requirements.xlsx
